title: Protect your Nodestro data
refused: Nodestro did not open its database because other users of this computer may change it. Your workflows, keys and results belong to you alone: restrict the database files to your user.
requested: You asked to restrict the database files to your user. Check the change and confirm it.

skipped.hard_link: Left alone: the file has another name (hard link)
skipped.other_owner: Left alone: belongs to another user
skipped.not_a_file: Left alone: not a regular file
skipped.changed_during_repair: Left alone: changed during the repair
skipped.other_file_refused: Left alone: another file could not be repaired

what: Nodestro changes only the permissions of these files, never their content. Nothing changes until you confirm.
confirm: Yes, from now on only my user may access these files.
notRepairable: Nodestro cannot repair these files itself. Repair them by hand, then start Nodestro again.
manual: Or repair it yourself in a terminal, then close and restart Nodestro:
cancelled: Nothing was changed. Nodestro stays locked until the permissions of the database are repaired: repair them here, or in a terminal and then close and restart Nodestro.
repaired: Done: only your user can access the database now. Nodestro restarts.
failedTitle: The permissions could not be repaired. Nothing was changed; Nodestro stays locked.
planChanged: The files changed since they were shown. Check them again before you confirm.
loadFailed: The database files could not be checked.
genericManual: Or repair it yourself in a terminal (put in your Nodestro data folder for DATA_FOLDER), then close and restart Nodestro:
failedDoesNotOpen: The database does not open with the repaired permissions ({{cause}}). The old permissions were set back, so nothing was changed; Nodestro stays locked.
failedNotRestored: The permissions could not be repaired, and these files could not be set back to their old permissions: {{files}}. Nodestro stays locked; check them in a terminal.
alreadyPrivate: Only your user can access these files already, for example because you repaired them by hand. Continue to start Nodestro.
alreadyPrivateRestarting: Already private: nothing had to be changed. Nodestro restarts.
returning: Nothing was changed. Nodestro returns to the studio.
